var_action: VAR review; red card issued
assessment_authority: Premier League KMI Panel; FA Regulatory Commission
assessment_text: The KMI Panel judged the missed on-field DOGSO red-card decision incorrect (3:2) and the VAR intervention correct (3:2), although two members thought the subjective possession question did not justify intervention.
